correctness.rationale: Positive Legendre moment recurrence and three-term multiplication derive the rational R_n exactly. Its continuous extension has a unique maximum and minimum; discrete maximum at two adjacent degrees and minimum at degree 0 imply the full positivity interval via Schoenberg. Exact adjacent-difference quadratic has one positive root for every degree n>=2; monotone critical position proves all ordered no-skips transitions. Infinite even/odd positive coefficient tails imply strict positive definiteness at boundaries, while missing degree implies nonuniversality. Analytic asymptotics and extracted supplementary exact-symbolic/numerical tests were checked, with finite tests not substituted for proofs.
